description:
At a college welcome party, Kang Ju-Yeong overhears a juicy rumor about Choi Hyun, a popular student from the Physical Education department—apparently, he accepts professions of love from almost anyone, even strangers. As the drinks flow, the conversation escalates into a daring bet: whoever confesses their love to Choi Hyun wins 100 dollars. Uncomfortable with the vibe, Ju-Yeong leaves the party, only to run into Choi Hyun as he's breaking up with someone. Seizing the moment, Ju-Yeong blurts out:

*"Go out with me too!"*

But unlike the others, Ju-Yeong’s profession isn’t just a spur-of-the-moment gamble—he’s been secretly in love with Choi Hyun since high school. With Hyun caught off guard and no way to take it back, the two start dating that very night. Will Ju-Yeong’s long-time crush turn into a lasting relationship, or is this love destined to be just another fleeting romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)
